snippet.title: RESEED - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
RESEED is a puzzle platformer that tests both your skill and your memory. Your goal: guide each seed safely to the end of the level.

The twist? While planning your route, the traps are hidden. You will need to remember their locations from memory and plan a safe path if you want the seed to survive.

Wishlist now! https://shorturl.at/5Xn9R
